messages:
oncall-bot: :warning: INCIDENT: Canary 'canary-2026-03-15b' for model redwood-l2-13b-int8 failing healthchecks in eu-central-1. Routing fallback is configured with sticky_variant and cross-region spill to ap-southeast-1. Symptoms: elevated 5xxs and 99th latency. Paging: @cheng @simon @maria. See telemetry: https://internal/telemetry/2123460012
cheng: Got it, jumping in. Do we have an immediate customer impact count?
maria: quick metric dump: error rate peaked at 3.8% in the canary target shard, p99 increased ~1.1s. Canary started 09:12 UTC. Some clients observed retries and timeouts.
simon: if affinity is sticking clients to a slower variant in ap-southeast-1, that explains the p99. I'm thinking immediate action: 1) pause canary; 2) evict all sticky affinities for the canary session bucket; 3) enforce region_local fallback. Who can run the evict?
cheng: pausing canary now:
```
# pause canary rollout
rw rollout pause --canary canary-2026-03-15b --region eu-central-1
```
cheng: CLI: "success: canary canary-2026-03-15b paused (PAUSED)" 09:25 UTC
oncall-bot: Action: canary paused by cheng at 09:25 UTC.
elaine: CS notes: 5 customers opened tickets, mostly timeouts and higher latency when routed to ap-southeast-1. Notified via status page and direct outreach for top-2. No data integrity issues.
maria: checking routing policy file. Found: 
```yaml
route:
  model: redwood-l2-13b-int8
  canary: true
  fallback:
    strategy: variant_preference
    sticky_variant: true
    region_fallback: allow_cross_region
    affinity_ttl_seconds: 86400
```
maria: affinity TTL=86400s (24h) and sticky_variant=true — that's definitely too long for canaries.
simon: let's evict affinities for the canary keyspace and push a targeted policy change to prefer region_local for canaries.
cheng: running affinity eviction and hotpatch:
```
# evict affinities for canary
rw routing affinity evict --canary canary-2026-03-15b --scope all
# set canary fallback defaults
rw config set routing.canary.default.sticky_variant=false
rw config set routing.canary.default.region_fallback=region_prefer
rw config set routing.canary.default.affinity_ttl_seconds=60
rw deploy config --env prod --region eu-central-1 --hotpatch
```
infra-bot: Config change detected by cheng: routing.canary.default.* updated. Hotpatch applied: routing.hotpatch.v21 at 09:31 UTC.
maria: re-running synthetic health checks and sampling client traces. Early signs: errors dropping, p99 trending down toward baseline.
ops-bot: Observability alert cleared for canary error spike at 09:38 UTC.
customer-success: status update posted: "We paused a canary rollout in eu-central-1 and applied a routing hotfix to reduce cross-region failover impact. We're monitoring and following up with affected customers."
simon: follow-ups: 1) change default to disallow sticky_variant for canaries unless explicitly approved; 2) add preflight perf verification comparing variant perf across regions; 3) add automated affinity-evict step on canary pause; 4) reduce affinity TTL default for any canary to 60s. I'll own the postmortem.
cheng: created ticket INC-2026-2123460012 and assigned to simon for postmortem.
elaine: impact estimates: ~22k requests touched canary during window, ~1.4k requests observed with degraded latency or failures (~6.4% impacted). Will attach customer list and outreach notes to the ticket.
maria: i'll open a PR for the config linter to block sticky_variant on routes where canary=true, and add an automated test to run variant perf check during model onboarding.
simon: thanks. I'm scheduling a 30min AAR in 48 hours. For now, incident = mitigated, keeping channel open for 1 hour to watch for regressions. :thumbsup:
